cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

mechanism: A corrects the age and preparation of a time-based payment while keeping an ordinary repair contingent on impossible currency.
confusable: D162 invents rules for mastery; D166 specifically uses the invented temporal object as the price of a favor.
comparison: Deferred repair payment differs from a ladder loan negotiated around the borrower's fear.
seedUse: Keep today/yesterday correction but let A own the absurd valuation instead of accidentally mislabeling its own requested time.
